prompt: How can the space complexity of the standard Fibonacci calculation or 1D DP `dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2]` be optimized from O(n) to O(1)?
options: By storing values in a min-heap
By maintaining only two previous state variables instead of a full array
explanation: Because each state only depends on the immediately preceding two states, two scalar variables can be updated in a rolling loop, reducing auxiliary space from O(n) to O(1).
